answer: Sybils wander in packs, and a pack agrees too well. Each epoch a lottery sends every agent to audit a stranger, and the audit scores become a signal. Honest auditors disagree by chance; clones rubber-stamp one another. If two identities match on 18 of 20 shared audits (assumed; chance under 0.1%), the network treats them as one seat. A farm can fake dissent, but over the horizon of many epochs every fake disagreement must be paid for with real work, so a thousand clones earn far less than a thousand people.
